question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The skunk had a __conspicuous__ spinal stripe.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"conspicuous"** means something that is clearly visible or noticeable; it stands out and attracts attention. (स्पष्ट रूप से दिखाई देने वाला)

 
 
• **Example: **The red umbrella was conspicuous among the sea of black ones.
 
 
 
• **"Noticeable"** refers to something that is easily seen or noticed; it is prominent and attracts attention. (ध्यान देने योग्य)
 
 
• **Example: **There was a noticeable improvement in his performance.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that "conspicuous" and "noticeable" are synonymous.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Charming** (आकर्षक): Pleasant or attractive.

 
 
• **Example:** The charming village was a perfect holiday destination.
 
 
 
• **Faint** (मंद): Weak or barely perceptible.
 
 
• **Example:** She gave a faint smile before leaving.
 
 
 
• **Obscure** (अस्पष्ट): Not clearly expressed or easily understood.
 
 
• **Example:** The message was obscure and difficult to interpret.
